description: Toyota's stock ACC command (0x343 ACCEL_CMD from the radar) against the radar's ACC target on two cars: U1 (229 s following at 30-43 m) and the second car's stock-ACC drive (138 s scoreable: cruise on, no gas or brake, >= 2 s after gas, ACC target present). Law: u = c_d d + c_v vEgo + c_vr vRel + c_ar aRel + c0 through a dead time, first-order lag and rate limit fitted on U1, simulated free-running from the inputs; optional set-speed cap u = min(u, k (v_set - v) + c). Exploratory.

cmd_passes_filter.note: the second car has a board in the radar's car-bus line; on stock ACC it passes the radar's 0x343 unchanged

far_closing.note: a closing car becomes the ACC target at 94 m

second_car.lead_changes: three ACC-target switches, all under gas override or at the set-speed cap: not usable

u1_standstill_hold.note: not engaged, stopped (< 0.5 m/s) behind a lead (MINI_CAR 1): ACCEL_CMD value shares
